name: LiFE (dwi)
summary: Evaluates a tractogram with LiFE (Linear Fascicle Evaluation), predicting a preprocessed DWI from the streamlines of a .tck file, and outputs fascicle weights and model error.
description: Builds the LiFE model from the tractogram and the DWI, fits non-negative fascicle weights with the bbnnls solver, and reports the voxel-wise RMSE and the number of streamlines with non-zero weight. Use it to remove streamlines that do not contribute to predicting the diffusion signal (connectome evaluation) before further analysis. Needs a tractogram and a preprocessed DWI from the same subject, in the same space; large tractograms need substantial memory.

inputs.description: Whole-brain tractogram (.tck) to evaluate, in the same space as the DWI.
you should feed preprocessed dwi. we will add preprocessed datatype tag once we have most preprocessed dwi tagged with "preprocessed"

outputs.description: LiFE model (output_fe.mat) with the fitted fascicle weights and voxel-wise RMSE, plus a subsampled JSON of the non-zero-weight streamlines for visualisation.

parameters.description: Number of discretised orientations used to build the LiFE fascicle model (feConnectomeInit).
Number of iterations of the bbnnls solver used to fit the LiFE model weights.

failure_modes.cause: The LiFE fit did not complete.
failure_modes.fix: Check the log; make sure the tractogram and DWI are aligned and that enough memory is available.
